artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initialValue: number = input.initial_value
	local currentValue: number = input.current_value

	if initialValue == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local function roundTo2(x: number): number
		if x >= 0 then
			return math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		else
			return math.ceil(x * 100 - 0.5) / 100
		end
	end

	local rawPct: number = ((currentValue - initialValue) / initialValue) * 100
	local pct: number = roundTo2(rawPct)

	local direction: string
	if pct > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif pct < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes percent change from initial_value to current_value (rounded to 2 decimals) and returns direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a reusable percent-change calculation with a simple trend direction indicator.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if listed.ok == false then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for _, c: CustomerRef in listed.customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= 10 then
				break
			end
			sends += 1
			local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local r = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			if r.ok == false then
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local function round2(x: number): number
		-- Round to 2 decimals (half up)
		local scaled = x * 100
		if scaled >= 0 then
			return math.floor(scaled + 0.5) / 100
		else
			return math.ceil(scaled - 0.5) / 100
		end
	end

	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local pct = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pctRounded = round2(pct)

	local direction: string
	if pctRounded > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif pctRounded < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pctRounded, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes 2-decimal percentage change from initial to current and returns direction up/down/flat.
